input.overview: Serve five customers to reach Dine-Time. Each customer takes one completion of the six drop targets; completing the E-A-T lanes lights both food ramps so either lit ramp spots an entire bank. For Multiball, shoot the right Cup ramp to raise the left ramp, lock a ball beneath it, then shoot the upper-left saucer to release the lock and start two-ball play.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the six drop targets once for each customer, using the E-A-T lanes to light both ramps for an instant bank completion. For two-ball Multiball, shoot the right Cup ramp, lock a ball under the raised left ramp, then shoot the upper-left saucer. After serving all five customers, shoot that saucer again to start Dine-Time.
input.summary: Serve five customers by completing the six drop targets. E-A-T lights both ramps to spot a full bank. For two-ball Multiball, shoot the Cup ramp, lock beneath the raised left ramp, then shoot the upper-left saucer. After customer five, shoot the saucer for Dine-Time.

steps.text: Complete the E-A-T lanes to light both serve-food ramps.
Shoot either lit ramp to spot all six drop targets and serve the current customer, or complete the six targets directly.
Shoot the right Cup ramp to raise the left ramp and open its lock for a short time.
Shoot beneath the raised left ramp to lock a ball, then shoot the upper-left saucer to release it and start two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the upper-left saucer and then the Today's Special sinkhole to light both ramps for 500,000 through the rest of that Multiball.

alternatives.title: Start Dine-Time
alternatives.when: Use this after the fifth customer has been served.

steps.text: Shoot the upper-left saucer to start the timed Dine-Time clock.
Return to the saucer before time expires to collect the displayed clock value, worth one million per remaining unit.
Favor E-A-T completions when the top feed is safe; each lit food ramp replaces six separate drop-target hits.
Use the left cash-register ramp between customers to build its repeat award and later Dine-Time progress.
Serve customer five, then prioritize the upper-left saucer before its Dine-Time value falls.

machineSetup: Confirm the extra-ball, Today's Special, and progressive-award settings before competitive play.
Test all six drop targets, E-A-T lanes, both ramps, the left-ramp lift and lock, upper-left saucer, Cup ramp, and Today's Special sinkhole.

cautions.issue: The Cup ramp opens the left-ramp lock only briefly.
cautions.response: Settle the return when possible, but shoot the raised left-ramp opening before it closes.
